Subtract 37 weeks and 2 days = 37*7 + 2 = 261 days.  
1628 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rule after 1582).  
01-04-1628 is April 1, 1628.  
Going back 261 days:  
April 1 → back 1 day → March 31 (day 91 of year).  
March has 31 days, February 29 (leap year), January 31.  
From March 31 back 31 days → March 1 (day 61).  
From March 1 back 29 days → February 1 (day 32).  
From February 1 back 31 days → January 1 (day 1).  
That’s 31+29+31 = 91 days back to Jan 1.  
Remaining days: 261 - 91 = 170 days earlier into 1627.  
1627 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
From Dec 31, 1627 count back:  
Dec (31) + Nov (30) + Oct (31) + Sep (30) + Aug (31) = 153 days.  
Remaining 170 - 153 = 17 days into July 1627.  
July has 31 days, so July 31 minus 17 days = July 14, 1627.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1627-07-14
